name: Sofia Yates
life: “I still remember my first pupil saying I played too fast.” Monday often includes a stop at Harbour Bakery, where Sofia buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I was scared my students would laugh at my playing. One of them started the count for me.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a plum-colored cardigan and a train token tied to a zipper pull. Sofia has a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek, with short sandy hair and a marked widow's peak. Sofia draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first during a conversation.
personality: Sofia can be lavish with time and quite careful with cash. A free afternoon is sometimes the biggest gift Sofia can afford to give, and family knows to take it seriously.
agenda: To let pupils hear an honest adult practice session.
family: Rosemary Bhandari is Sofia’s older cousin. Sofia asks before bringing somebody along. Rosemary can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *Money after marriage*, Rosemary says, “I was their first lender. The woman I underestimated has been paying every installment.”
connections: Hollis Fong. The kitchen percussionist and the teacher discover how to practice standing together.

reactions.situation: A child freezes halfway through the song
reactions.response: Sofia lets the beat drop out and waits for the child to choose whether to rejoin.

reactions.situation: Someone begins blaming the youngest worker for a missing item
reactions.response: Sofia asks everybody to retrace their own last ordinary actions before asking the young worker a question.

reactions.situation: If invited to an expensive outing
reactions.response: Sofia suggests meeting afterward and explains why without asking the others to abandon their plans.
